mapper.select: select ifnull(sum(ifnull(wod.mete, 0)), 0) mete, ifnull(sum(ifnull(wod.quantity, 0)), 0) quantity, ifnull(sum(ifnull(wod.input_VAT, 0)), 0) inputVAT, ifnull(sum(ifnull(wod.amount, 0)), 0) amount, ifnull(sum(ifnull(wod.amount_excluding_VAT, 0)), 0) amountExcludingVAT, (select unit_price_excluding_VAT from wms_move_outbound_detail order by create_time desc LIMIT 1) unitPriceExcludingVAT from wms_move_outbound_detail wod left join wms_outbound wo on wo.id = wod.outbound_id where wod.weighted_average_price_id = #{wapId} and wo.review_status = 2 and wod.bool_delete_enum = 0

select CASE WHEN #{amountType} = 1 THEN ifnull(sum(amount), 0) WHEN #{amountType} = 2 THEN ifnull(sum(amount_excluding_vat), 0) end from wms_move_outbound_detail wod left join wms_outbound wo on wo.id = wod.outbound_id where wod.bool_delete_enum = 0 and wo.review_status = 2 AND wod.project_id = #{projectId} and wod.basic_class & 7 > 0

select DATE_FORMAT(wod.create_time, '%c') v, ifnull(sum(wod.mete), 0) v2 from wms_move_outbound_detail wod left join wms_outbound wo on wo.id = wod.outbound_id where wod.bool_delete_enum = 0 and wo.review_status = 2 and wod.project_id = #{projectId} and DATE_FORMAT(wod.create_time, '%y') = DATE_FORMAT(#{year}, '%y') group by DATE_FORMAT(wod.create_time, '%c')

select wod.*, wo.review_time createTime from wms_move_outbound_detail wod left join wms_outbound wo on wo.id = wod.outbound_id where wod.bool_delete_enum = 0 and wo.bool_delete_enum = 0 and wo.review_status = 2 and (wo.review_time > #{times[0]} and wo.review_time < #{times[1]} ) and wod.classify_id in
#{classifyId}

select wc.id, wc.name from wms_move_outbound_detail a left join wms_outbound b on a.outbound_id = b.id left join wms_classification wc on a.classify_id = wc.id where a.bool_delete_enum = 0 and b.review_status = 2 and b.bool_delete_enum = 0 and a.basic_class = #{basicClass} and DATE_FORMAT(a.create_time, '%Y') = #{year} and DATE_FORMAT(a.create_time, '%Y%m') < DATE_FORMAT(#{now}, '%Y%m') group by wc.id, wc.name

select a.classify_id classifyId, sum(a.amount) amount, sum(a.amount_excluding_vat) amountExcludingVAT from wms_move_outbound_detail a left join wms_outbound b on a.outbound_id = b.id left join wms_classification wc on a.classify_id = wc.id where a.bool_delete_enum = 0 and b.review_status = 2 and b.bool_delete_enum = 0 and a.basic_class = #{basicClass} and a.amount is not null and DATE_FORMAT(a.create_time, '%Y%m') = #{date} group by a.classify_id

SELECT temp1.project_id, temp1.amount - IFNULL(temp2.amount, 0) amount FROM ( SELECT wmod.project_id, IFNULL( SUM( wmod.amount ), 0 ) amount FROM wms_move_outbound_detail wmod INNER JOIN wms_outbound wo ON wmod.outbound_id = wo.id WHERE wmod.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND wo.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND wo.review_status = 2 AND wmod.project_id in
#{id}
AND wmod.basic_class & #{basicClassEnum} > 0
GROUP BY wmod.project_id ) AS temp1 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT wrd.project_id, IFNULL( SUM( wrd.amount ), 0 ) amount FROM wms_return_detail AS wrd INNER JOIN wms_return AS wr ON wrd.return_id = wr.id WHERE wrd.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND wr.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND wr.review_status = 2 AND wrd.project_id IN
#{id}
AND wrd.basic_class & #{basicClassEnum} > 0
GROUP BY wrd.project_id ) temp2 ON temp1.project_id = temp2.project_id

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(wmod.outbound_time, '%Y%m') month, IFNULL(SUM(wmod.amount), 0) amount FROM wms_move_outbound_detail wmod INNER JOIN wms_outbound wo ON wmod.outbound_id = wo.id AND wo.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND wo.review_status = 2 WHERE wmod.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND wmod.project_id IS NULL AND wmod.basic_class & #{basicClassEnum} > 0 AND DATE_FORMAT( wmod.outbound_time , '%Y%m' ) <= #{endMonth} AND DATE_FORMAT( wmod.outbound_time , '%Y%m' ) > #{startMonth} GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

select ifnull(sum(a.mete), 0) from wms_move_outbound_detail a left join wms_outbound b on a.outbound_id = b.id left join wms_classification wc on a.classify_id = wc.id where a.bool_delete_enum = 0 and b.review_status = 2 and b.bool_delete_enum = 0 and a.basic_class & #{basicClass} > 0 and DATE_FORMAT(a.create_time , '%Y%m') = #{year}

SELECT sum( wod.mete ) FROM wms_outbound wo LEFT JOIN wms_move_outbound_detail wod ON wo.id = wod.outbound_id WHERE wo.review_status = 2 AND wod.basic_class IN ( 1, 2, 4 ) AND wod.create_time >= DATE_FORMAT( CURDATE() - INTERVAL 1 MONTH, '%Y-%m-01' ) AND wod.create_time < DATE_FORMAT( CURDATE(), '%Y-%m-01' );

SELECT wmod.project_id id, IFNULL(SUM( wmod.mete ), 0 ) / 1000000 AS mete FROM wms_move_outbound_detail wmod LEFT JOIN wms_outbound wo ON wmod.outbound_id = wo.id AND wo.bool_delete_enum = 0 WHERE wmod.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND wo.review_status = 2 AND wo.outbound_type_selection = 1 AND wo.outbound_type_selection = 1 AND wmod.basic_class & 263 > 0 GROUP BY wmod.project_id

SELECT wmod.workshop_id id, IFNULL(SUM( wmod.mete ), 0 ) / 1000000 AS mete FROM wms_move_outbound_detail wmod LEFT JOIN wms_outbound wo ON wmod.outbound_id = wo.id AND wo.bool_delete_enum = 0 WHERE wmod.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND wo.review_status = 2 AND wo.outbound_type_selection = 1 AND wmod.basic_class & 263 > 0 GROUP BY wmod.workshop_id

SELECT temp1.dateTime as dateTime, (temp1.mete - IFNULL(temp2.mete, 0)) / 1000 as mete FROM ( SELECT DATE_FORMAT(wmod.create_time, "%Y-%m") as dateTime, IFNULL( SUM( wmod.mete ), 0 ) mete FROM wms_move_outbound_detail wmod INNER JOIN wms_outbound wo ON wmod.outbound_id = wo.id WHERE wmod.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND wo.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND wo.review_status = 2 and wo.outbound_type_selection = 1
AND wmod.project_id in
#{projectId}
AND wmod.basic_class & #{basicClassEnum} > 0
AND DATE_FORMAT(wmod.create_time, "%Y-%m") >= DATE_FORMAT(#{startDate}, "%Y-%m")
AND DATE_FORMAT(#{endDate}, "%Y-%m") >= DATE_FORMAT(wmod.create_time, "%Y-%m")
AND EXISTS( select 1 from project_branch_company_link pbcl where pbcl.bool_delete_enum = FALSE AND pbcl.branch_company_level = 2 and pbcl.branch_company_id = #{branchCompanyId} and pbcl.project_id = wmod.project_id )
AND wmod.workshop_id = #{workshopId}
group by DATE_FORMAT(wmod.create_time, "%Y-%m") ) AS temp1 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DATE_FORMAT(wrd.create_time, "%Y-%m") as dateTime, IFNULL( SUM( wrd.mete ), 0 ) mete FROM wms_return_detail AS wrd INNER JOIN wms_return AS wr ON wrd.return_id = wr.id LEFT JOIN wms_material_returnable wmr ON wrd.material_returnable_id = wmr.id AND wmr.bool_delete_enum = 0 WHERE wrd.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND wr.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND wr.review_status = 2
AND wrd.project_id in
#{projectId}
AND wrd.basic_class & #{basicClassEnum} > 0
AND DATE_FORMAT(wrd.create_time, "%Y-%m") >= DATE_FORMAT(#{startDate}, "%Y-%m")
AND DATE_FORMAT(#{endDate}, "%Y-%m") >= DATE_FORMAT(wrd.create_time, "%Y-%m")
AND EXISTS( select 1 from project_branch_company_link pbcl where pbcl.bool_delete_enum = FALSE AND pbcl.branch_company_level = 2 and pbcl.branch_company_id = #{branchCompanyId} and pbcl.project_id = wrd.project_id )
AND wmr.workshop_id = #{workshopId}
and wr.outbound_type_selection = 1 group by DATE_FORMAT(wrd.create_time, "%Y-%m" ) ) temp2 ON temp1.dateTime = temp2.dateTime

SELECT cp.id AS 'projectInfo.id', cp.`name` AS 'projectInfo.name', cp.short_name AS 'projectInfo.short_name', cp.serial_number AS 'projectInfo.serial_number', (IFNULL(a.outMete,0) - IFNULL(c.returnMete,0)) / 1000 as loseMete, IFNULL(b.mete,0) as mete, CASE WHEN IFNULL(a.outMete,0) - IFNULL(c.returnMete,0) = 0 THEN 0 WHEN b.mete IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(((IFNULL(a.outMete,0) - IFNULL(c.returnMete,0)) / 1000 - IFNULL(b.mete,0)) * 100 / ((IFNULL(a.outMete,0) - IFNULL(c.returnMete,0)) / 1000), 2) END AS ratio FROM contract_project as cp LEFT join( SELECT wmod.project_id, IFNULL( SUM( wmod.mete ), 0 ) as outMete FROM wms_move_outbound_detail wmod LEFT JOIN wms_outbound wo ON wmod.outbound_id = wo.id WHERE wmod.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND wo.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND wo.review_status = 2 and wo.outbound_type_selection = 1 and wmod.project_id is not null
AND wmod.basic_class & #{basicClass} > 0
AND DATE_FORMAT(wmod.create_time, "%Y-%m") = DATE_FORMAT(#{mouthDate}, "%Y-%m")
AND EXISTS( select 1 from project_branch_company_link pbcl where pbcl.bool_delete_enum = FALSE AND pbcl.branch_company_level = 2 and pbcl.branch_company_id = #{branchCompanyId} and pbcl.project_id = wmod.project_id )
AND wmod.workshop_id = #{workshopId}
group by wmod.project_id )a on a.project_id = cp.id
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT complete.project_id, sum(complete.quantity * artifact.net_weight) as mete FROM mes_building_complete complete LEFT JOIN tech_artifact artifact ON artifact.id = complete.product_id and artifact.bool_delete_enum = 0 LEFT JOIN contract_project as cp on cp.id = artifact.project_id and cp.bool_delete_enum = FALSE WHERE complete.task_type_enum = 2 and complete.bool_delete_enum = 0
AND DATE_FORMAT(complete.create_time, "%Y-%m" ) = DATE_FORMAT(#{mouthDate}, "%Y-%m")
AND EXISTS( select 1 from project_branch_company_link pbcl where pbcl.bool_delete_enum = FALSE AND pbcl.branch_company_level = 2 and pbcl.branch_company_id = #{branchCompanyId} and pbcl.project_id = cp.id )
AND complete.workshop_id = #{workshopId}
group by complete.project_id )b ON b.project_id = cp.id
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT wrd.project_id, IFNULL( SUM( wrd.mete ), 0 ) returnMete FROM wms_return_detail AS wrd INNER JOIN wms_return AS wr ON wrd.return_id = wr.id LEFT JOIN wms_material_returnable wmr ON wrd.material_returnable_id = wmr.id AND wmr.bool_delete_enum = 0 WHERE wrd.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND wr.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND wr.review_status = 2 and wr.outbound_type_selection = 1 AND wrd.project_id is not null
AND wrd.basic_class & #{basicClass} > 0
AND DATE_FORMAT(wrd.create_time, "%Y-%m") = DATE_FORMAT(#{mouthDate}, "%Y-%m")
AND EXISTS( select 1 from project_branch_company_link pbcl where pbcl.bool_delete_enum = FALSE AND pbcl.branch_company_level = 2 and pbcl.branch_company_id = #{branchCompanyId} and pbcl.project_id = wrd.project_id )
AND wmr.workshop_id = #{workshopId}
group by wrd.project_id )c on c.project_id = cp.id where b.mete is not null or (IFNULL(a.outMete,0) - IFNULL(c.returnMete,0)) != 0

SELECT temp1.dateTime as dateTime, temp1.classify_id as classifyId, wc.name as classifyName, (temp1.amount - IFNULL(temp2.amount, 0)) as amount, (temp1.amount_excluding_vat - IFNULL(temp2.amount_excluding_vat, 0)) as amount_excluding_vat FROM ( SELECT DATE_FORMAT( wmod.create_time, "%Y-%m" ) AS dateTime, wmod.classify_id, IFNULL( SUM( wmod.amount), 0 ) amount, IFNULL( SUM( wmod.amount_excluding_vat), 0 ) amount_excluding_vat FROM wms_move_outbound_detail wmod LEFT JOIN wms_outbound wo ON wmod.outbound_id = wo.id AND wo.bool_delete_enum = 0 WHERE wmod.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND wo.review_status = 2 and wo.outbound_type_selection = 1
AND wmod.project_id in
#{projectId}
AND wmod.basic_class & #{basicClassEnum} > 0
AND DATE_FORMAT(wmod.create_time, "%Y") = DATE_FORMAT(#{yearDate}, "%Y")
AND EXISTS( select 1 from project_branch_company_link pbcl where pbcl.bool_delete_enum = FALSE AND pbcl.branch_company_level = 2 and pbcl.branch_company_id = #{branchCompanyId} and pbcl.project_id = wmod.project_id )
AND wmod.workshop_id = #{workshopId}
group by DATE_FORMAT(wmod.create_time, "%Y-%m"), wmod.classify_id ) AS temp1 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DATE_FORMAT( wrd.create_time, "%Y-%m" ) AS dateTime, wrd.classify_id, IFNULL( SUM( wrd.amount), 0 ) amount, IFNULL( SUM( wrd.amount_excluding_vat), 0 ) amount_excluding_vat FROM wms_return_detail AS wrd LEFT JOIN wms_return AS wr ON wrd.return_id = wr.id AND wr.bool_delete_enum = 0 LEFT JOIN wms_material_returnable wmr ON wrd.material_returnable_id = wmr.id AND wmr.bool_delete_enum = 0 WHERE wrd.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND wr.review_status = 2
AND wrd.project_id in
#{projectId}
AND wrd.basic_class & #{basicClassEnum} > 0
AND DATE_FORMAT(wrd.create_time, "%Y") = DATE_FORMAT(#{yearDate}, "%Y")
AND EXISTS( select 1 from project_branch_company_link pbcl where pbcl.bool_delete_enum = FALSE AND pbcl.branch_company_level = 2 and pbcl.branch_company_id = #{branchCompanyId} and pbcl.project_id = wrd.project_id )
AND wmr.workshop_id = #{workshopId}
and wr.outbound_type_selection = 1 group by DATE_FORMAT(wrd.create_time, "%Y-%m"), wrd.classify_id ) temp2 ON temp1.dateTime = temp2.dateTime and temp1.classify_id = temp2.classify_id LEFT join wms_classification wc on temp1.classify_id = wc.id AND wc.bool_delete_enum = 0

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(wmod.create_time, "%Y-%m") as dateTime, IFNULL( SUM( wmod.mete ), 0 ) totalMete, IFNULL( SUM( wmod.amount_excluding_vat ), 0 ) totalCost FROM wms_move_outbound_detail wmod INNER JOIN wms_outbound wo ON wmod.outbound_id = wo.id WHERE wmod.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND wo.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND wo.review_status = 2
AND wmod.basic_class & #{basicClass} > 0
and wmod.classify_id in
#{item}
AND DATE_FORMAT(wmod.create_time, "%Y") = DATE_FORMAT(#{yearDate}, "%Y")
AND EXISTS( select 1 from project_branch_company_link pbcl where pbcl.bool_delete_enum = FALSE AND pbcl.branch_company_level = 2 and pbcl.branch_company_id = #{branchCompanyId} and pbcl.project_id = wmod.project_id )
AND wmod.workshop_id = #{workshopId}
group by DATE_FORMAT(wmod.create_time, "%Y-%m")

SELECT p.id as 'project.id', p.name as 'project.name', p.short_name as 'project.shortName', p.serial_number as 'project.serialNumber', (IFNULL(temp1.total_mete,0) - IFNULL(temp2.total_mete,0)) / 1000 as outMete, (IFNULL(temp1.current_month_mete,0) - IFNULL(temp2.current_month_mete,0)) / 1000 as currentOutMete, (IFNULL(temp1.last_month_mete,0) - IFNULL(temp2.last_month_mete,0)) / 1000 as lastOutMete FROM contract_project p LEFT JOIN ( SELECT wmod.project_id, IFNULL(SUM(wmod.mete), 0) AS total_mete, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN DATE_FORMAT(wmod.create_time, "%Y-%m") = DATE_FORMAT(CURRENT_DATE(), "%Y-%m") THEN wmod.mete ELSE 0 END), 0) AS current_month_mete, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN DATE_FORMAT(wmod.create_time, "%Y-%m") = DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH), "%Y-%m") THEN wmod.mete ELSE 0 END), 0) AS last_month_mete FROM wms_move_outbound_detail wmod INNER JOIN wms_outbound wo ON wmod.outbound_id = wo.id WHERE wmod.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND wo.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND wo.review_status = 2 AND wo.outbound_type_selection = 1
AND wmod.basic_class & #{basicClass} > 0
AND DATE_FORMAT(wmod.create_time, "%Y") = DATE_FORMAT(#{yearDate}, "%Y")
AND EXISTS( select 1 from project_branch_company_link pbcl where pbcl.bool_delete_enum = FALSE AND pbcl.branch_company_level = 2 and pbcl.branch_company_id = #{branchCompanyId} and pbcl.project_id = wmod.project_id )
AND wmod.workshop_id = #{workshopId}
group by wmod.project_id ) AS temp1 ON temp1.project_id = p.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT wrd.project_id, IFNULL(SUM(wrd.mete), 0) AS total_mete, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN DATE_FORMAT(wrd.create_time, "%Y-%m") = DATE_FORMAT(CURRENT_DATE(), "%Y-%m") THEN wrd.mete ELSE 0 END), 0) AS current_month_mete, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN DATE_FORMAT(wrd.create_time, "%Y-%m") = DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH), "%Y-%m") THEN wrd.mete ELSE 0 END), 0) AS last_month_mete FROM wms_return_detail AS wrd INNER JOIN wms_return AS wr ON wrd.return_id = wr.id WHERE wrd.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND wr.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND wr.review_status = 2 AND wr.outbound_type_selection = 1
AND wrd.basic_class & #{basicClass} > 0
AND DATE_FORMAT(wrd.create_time, "%Y") >= DATE_FORMAT(#{yearDate}, "%Y")
AND EXISTS( select 1 from project_branch_company_link pbcl where pbcl.bool_delete_enum = FALSE AND pbcl.branch_company_level = 2 and pbcl.branch_company_id = #{branchCompanyId} and pbcl.project_id = wrd.project_id )
AND wrd.workshop_id = #{workshopId}
group by wrd.project_id ) temp2 ON temp2.project_id = p.id where p.bool_delete_enum = 0
AND p.status = #{status}

SELECT y_t.`year` as `dateTime`, (IFNULL(temp1.mete, 0) - IFNULL(temp2.mete, 0)) as mete FROM (
select DATE_FORMAT(#{i}, '%Y-%m') as `year`
) y_t LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DATE_FORMAT(wmod.create_time, "%Y-%m") as dateTime, IFNULL( SUM( wmod.mete ), 0 ) mete FROM wms_move_outbound_detail wmod INNER JOIN wms_outbound wo ON wmod.outbound_id = wo.id WHERE wmod.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND wo.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND wo.review_status = 2 and wo.outbound_type_selection = 1 AND wmod.basic_class & 263 > 0
AND EXISTS( select 1 from project_branch_company_link pbcl where pbcl.bool_delete_enum = FALSE AND pbcl.branch_company_level = 2 and pbcl.branch_company_id = #{branchCompanyId} and pbcl.project_id = wmod.project_id )
AND DATE_FORMAT(wmod.create_time, "%Y") = DATE_FORMAT(#{yearDate}, "%Y")
AND wmod.workshop_id = #{workshopId}
group by DATE_FORMAT(wmod.create_time, "%Y-%m") ) AS temp1 ON temp1.dateTime = y_t.`year` LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DATE_FORMAT(wrd.create_time, "%Y-%m") as dateTime, IFNULL( SUM( wrd.mete ), 0 ) mete FROM wms_return_detail AS wrd INNER JOIN wms_return AS wr ON wrd.return_id = wr.id LEFT JOIN wms_material_returnable wmr ON wrd.material_returnable_id = wmr.id AND wmr.bool_delete_enum = 0 WHERE wrd.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND wr.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND wr.review_status = 2 AND wrd.basic_class & 263 > 0
AND EXISTS( select 1 from project_branch_company_link pbcl where pbcl.bool_delete_enum = FALSE AND pbcl.branch_company_level = 2 and pbcl.branch_company_id = #{branchCompanyId} and pbcl.project_id = wrd.project_id )
AND wmr.workshop_id = #{workshopId}
AND DATE_FORMAT(wmr.create_time, "%Y") >= DATE_FORMAT(#{yearDate}, "%Y")
and wr.outbound_type_selection = 1 group by DATE_FORMAT(wrd.create_time, "%Y-%m" ) ) temp2 ON temp2.dateTime = y_t.`year`

select DATE_FORMAT(wid.create_time, "%Y-%m") as dateTime, IFNULL( SUM( wid.mete ), 0 ) totalMete, IFNULL( SUM( wid.amount_excluding_vat ), 0 ) totalCost from wms_statistics_outbound wid where wid.bool_delete_enum = 0
and wid.basic_class & #{basicClass} > 0
and wid.classify_id in
#{item}
AND DATE_FORMAT(wid.create_time, "%Y") = DATE_FORMAT(#{yearDate}, "%Y")
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM project_branch_company_link pbcl WHERE pbcl.bool_delete_enum=0 AND pbcl.branch_company_level=2 AND pbcl.branch_company_id=#{branchCompanyId} AND pbcl.project_id=wid.project_id)
AND wid.workshop_id=#{workshopId}
group by DATE_FORMAT(wid.create_time, "%Y-%m")

select wod.*, wo.id woId, wo.serial_number sn, wo.applicant_name founderName, wo.reviewer_name reviewerName, wo.create_time createTime, wo.review_time reviewTime, p.id pid, p.short_name psName, p.serial_number pSN, p.name pn, pm.name pmName, pa.name paName, mbf.id mbfId, mbf.name mbfName, wwork.id wworkId, wwork.name wworkName, wm.measure_unit wmu, wm.measure_precision wmp, wm.accounting_unit wau, wm.accounting_precision wap, ww.id wwId, ww.name wwName, su.name sname, spo.serial_number spoNumber, u.name uName, war.start_time warStartTime, wo.bool_scheduling boolScheduling, wo.outbound_type_selection woType, batch.name areaBatchName, wo.child_order_number childOrderNumber from wms_move_outbound_detail wod left join wms_outbound wo on wo.id = wod.outbound_id left join wms_measure wm on wm.classification_id = wod.classify_id left join contract_project p on p.id = wod.project_id left join mes_building_workshop mbf on wod.workshop_id = mbf.id left join wms_warehouse ww on ww.id = wod.warehouse_id left join sys_user su on su.id = wod.recipient_id left join plan_monomer pm on pm.id = wod.monomer_id left join plan_area pa on pa.id = wod.area_id left join wms_for_sale_detail wfsd on wfsd.outbound_detail_id = wod.id and wfsd.bool_delete_enum = 0 and exists (select 1 from wms_for_sale sale_parent where sale_parent.serial_number = wfsd.for_sale_serial_number and sale_parent.outbound_id = wod.outbound_id and sale_parent.bool_delete_enum = 0) left join scm_purchase_order spo on spo.id = wod.purchase_id left join sys_user u on u.id = wo.applicant_id left join wms_approve_record war on war.id = wo.approve_record_id left join wms_workshop wwork on wod.source_workshop_id = wwork.id left join plan_area_batch batch on batch.id = wod.area_batch_id and batch.bool_delete_enum = 0 where wod.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND wo.review_status = 2 and wod.outbound_id in
#{id}

SELECT IFNULL(SUM( wmod.mete ), 0 ) AS mete FROM wms_move_outbound_detail wmod LEFT JOIN wms_outbound wo ON wmod.outbound_id = wo.id AND wo.bool_delete_enum = 0 WHERE wmod.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND wo.review_status = 2 AND wo.outbound_type_selection in (1,128) AND wmod.project_id = #{projectId} AND wmod.classify_id = #{classifyId}
